name: Qadeer & Sheikh Law (Law Office of Qadeer & Sheikh, PC)
what_they_do: Immigration and family law practice led by Omar K. Qadeer, with a second office and international satellite offices. Immigration work centres on family petitions, green cards and status applications; family work on divorce, custody and related matrimonial matters. The site offers a free initial consultation, publishes a service-area section, and runs an FAQ and a reviews page.
customers: Immigrant families and individuals across New Jersey (with referral reach to Dubai and Lahore), plus divorcing/separating clients in Middlesex County.

size_signals.signal: Multiple offices listed: 517 Georges Rd North Brunswick NJ, 66 Main St Big Flats NY, plus satellite offices in Dubai (UAE) and Lahore (Pakistan)
Named attorney Omar K. Qadeer with Super Lawyers, Avvo and AIOFA listings; separate Attorneys and Awards pages
Staff referenced collectively as 'the team' with 'specialists', and reviews mention staff patience and communication

website_review.primary_cta: Phone number and 'Get in Touch' contact page, free initial consultation promised
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Contact form with Name / Email / Phone / Case fields behind Google reCAPTCHA; no appointment calendar
website_review.trust_signals: Reviews page, Awards page, FAQ page, service-area and office addresses, named attorney bio
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright reads 2025 (previous year); on the 390px contact view the hero headline 'Do You Need Help?' overlaps the 'Get In Touch' label
website_review.search_basics: Home title 'Home - Qadeer Law | Your Trusted Legal Support and Guidance' and the description are generic rather than service/town specific; has practice-area, FAQ and reviews pages; JSON-LD is Organization/WebSite only - no LocalBusiness with the Georges Road address
top_issues: Google reCAPTCHA sits in front of the contact form, so an AI agent cannot submit an enquiry
No LocalBusiness schema or hours; address and service area are prose only
No online booking - free consultation must be requested by form or phone
Home page title/description do not name 'immigration lawyer North Brunswick'

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: strong directory and review presence (Avvo 4.6/74) and a WordPress Yoast robots.txt that allows all crawlers with a sitemap index; no Google Business Profile rating confirmed. Answerable: better than most in this batch - service areas, four office addresses, FAQ page and free-consultation terms are all real text, and Organization JSON-LD exists, though it omits the street address, hours and services. Bookable: blocked - the enquiry form requires Google reCAPTCHA and there is no calendar, so an agent must stop and hand over to a human.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Put an agent-friendly path in front of the form: a labelled quote/consultation request without reCAPTCHA (or with an accessible alternative) plus written hours and intake expectations
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page loads https://google.com/recaptcha/api2/anchor in an iframe before submission, and only 1 label element exists for 4 fields

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness schema with the Georges Road address, hours, service area and practice areas, and rewrite the home title/description around immigration and family law in North Brunswick
top_opportunities.evidence: JSON-LD @graph contains Organization and WebSite entities only; home title is 'Home - Qadeer Law | Your Trusted Legal Support and Guidance' with a generic description

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automate intake triage and status follow-up for immigration enquiries (case type, deadlines, document checklist) so staff stop re-answering the same questions the FAQ page already covers
top_opportunities.evidence: Site runs a dedicated FAQ and Reviews page and promises a free consultation, but the only intake is a 4-field form that lands with staff; multiple offices and time zones make phone follow-up costly

scores.reasons: Gap: content and reviews are decent; the real gaps are the CAPTCHA wall, missing LocalBusiness schema/hours and generic home metadata. Ability to pay: multi-office firm with a healthy review base, but immigration/family fees are moderate. Ease: WordPress site where schema, labels and a booking page are days of work. Evidence: opened home and contact pages, read robots.txt and the JSON-LD, and checked the 390px layout.
